properties.title: Apache requests by HTTP status
properties.query: SOURCE 'aijaz-p17-logs' | filter @logStream like /apache-access/ | parse @message /"(?<method>[A-Z]+) (?<path>\S+) [^"]*" (?<status>\d{3})/ | stats count(*) as requests by status

properties.title: Requests over time
properties.query: SOURCE 'aijaz-p17-logs' | filter @logStream like /apache-access/ | stats count(*) as requests by bin(1m)

properties.title: Top requested pages
properties.query: SOURCE 'aijaz-p17-logs' | filter @logStream like /apache-access/ | parse @message /"(?<method>[A-Z]+) (?<path>\S+) [^"]*" (?<status>\d{3})/ | stats count(*) as hits by path, status | sort hits desc | limit 10
